name: 3D Animation
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Describe a scene, a fox exploring a snowy forest, a robot watering plants, a little dragon learning to fly, or pick a picture from your MegaScenes library to bring to life. You get a short clip in the look of a 3D animated film: stylized characters, soft light, rich colors and a smooth camera, in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1.

ChatGPT tells you what the clip needs and starts it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The clip plays in the chat when it is ready and stays in your library.

For social posts, stories for kids, greetings and short animations.

Limitations: a few seconds per clip; the look is described in general terms, not by a studio or film name. Pictures must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
